messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference for the Canadian federal holidays that create “long weekends” (i.e., a three‑day weekend) in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, or Thursday, it usually gives you an extra day off or a four‑day stretch.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Typical Long Weekend |
|---------|-------------|-------------|----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2** |
| Family Day (BC, AB, ON, SK, NB, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Mon Feb 20 – Sun Feb 26** |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **Mon May 22 – Sun May 28** |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Fri Jul 1 – Sun Jul 3** |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Mon Sep 4 – Sun Sep 10** |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Mon Oct 9 – Sun Oct 15** |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Thursday | **Thu Nov 11 – Sun Nov 14** |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Mon Dec 25 – Sun Dec 31** |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Tue Dec 26 – Sun Dec 31** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that can also create long weekends.  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekday that isn’t adjacent to a weekend, it won’t create a long weekend (e.g., Easter Monday in some provinces).

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app!
